{"script":"mkdir -p npm_check_workspace
cd npm_check_workspace || exit 1
# 2. Capture relevant environment variables
for v in PATH LD_LIBRARY_PATH NVM_DIR NODE_PATH NODE_HOME HOME SHELL USER; do printf '%s=%s\n' "$v" "${!v}"; done > env_snapshot.txt
# 3. Candidate installation locations
cat > candidate_paths.txt <<'EOS'
/usr/bin
/usr/local/bin
/bin
/snap/bin
/opt/node/bin
/opt/nodejs/bin
/usr/lib/node_modules/npm/bin
/home/*/.nvm/versions/node/*/bin
EOS
# 4. Search for any executable named npm
{ command -v -a npm 2>/dev/null || true; which -a npm 2>/dev/null || true; for d in $(echo "$PATH" | tr ':' '\n'); do [ -x "$d/npm" ] && printf '%s\n' "$d/npm"; done; find /usr /usr/local /opt /home -maxdepth 4 -type f -name npm -perm /111 2>/dev/null | sort -u || true; } > discovery_raw.txt
# 5. Record metadata for each discovered candidate
: > metadata.txt
if [ -s discovery_raw.txt ]; then
  grep -v '^$' discovery_raw.txt | sort -u | while read -r p; do
    printf 'PATH=%s\n' "$p" >> metadata.txt
    if [ -e "$p" ]; then
      ls -l --full-time "$p" >> metadata.txt 2>&1
      stat --format='Size=%s;Mode=%a;UID=%u;GID=%g;Type=%F;Atime=%x;Mtime=%y;Ctime=%z' "$p" >> metadata.txt 2>&1 || true
      file "$p" >> metadata.txt 2>&1 || true
      [ -x "$p" ] && printf 'EXECUTABLE=YES\n' >> metadata.txt || printf 'EXECUTABLE=NO\n' >> metadata.txt
    else
      printf 'EXISTS=NO\n' >> metadata.txt
    fi
    printf '----\n' >> metadata.txt
  done
else
  printf 'none\n' > metadata.txt
fi
# 6. Capture version output for executable candidates
: > version_raw.txt
if [ -s discovery_raw.txt ]; then
  grep -v '^$' discovery_raw.txt | sort -u | while read -r p; do
    if [ -x "$p" ]; then
      printf 'PATH=%s\n' "$p" >> version_raw.txt
      { "$p" --version 2>&1 || "$p" -v 2>&1 || printf 'NO_VERSION_OUTPUT\n'; } >> version_raw.txt
      printf '----\n' >> version_raw.txt
    else
      printf 'PATH=%s NOT_EXECUTABLE\n----\n' "$p" >> version_raw.txt
    fi
  done
else
  printf 'none\n' > version_raw.txt
fi
# 7. Re-capture env and compare
for v in PATH LD_LIBRARY_PATH NVM_DIR NODE_PATH NODE_HOME HOME SHELL USER; do printf '%s=%s\n' "$v" "${!v}"; done > env_after.txt
diff -u env_snapshot.txt env_after.txt > state_check.txt || true
# 8. Consolidate into report
{
  printf '=== DISCOVERY_RAW ===\n'; cat discovery_raw.txt; printf '\n=== METADATA ===\n'; cat metadata.txt; printf '\n=== VERSION_RAW ===\n'; cat version_raw.txt; printf '\n=== STATE_CHECK ===\n'; cat state_check.txt
} > npm_check_report.txt
# 9. Prepare cleanup marker
touch cleanup_pending.txt
# Determine final yes/no: consider npm installed if any discovered path is executable
installed=no
if [ -s discovery_raw.txt ]; then
  grep -v '^$' discovery_raw.txt | sort -u | while read -r p; do
    if [ -x "$p" ]; then
      installed=yes
      break
    fi
  done
fi
# Print final decision
printf '%s\n' "$installed"
"}
